title: Tech Note: Objects in Headers are Closer Than They Appear

historical_commentary.text: The ability to place objects in the header area of list forms was a new feature in 4D v6.5, expanding form layout flexibility. Modern 4D list forms continue to support header/footer areas with objects, though the form editor and available object types have expanded enormously. The basic concept remains valid.
related_updates: Header/footer areas in list forms remain a standard feature in modern 4D
The form editor and object types available for headers have been significantly expanded
